title: PATIENCE
description: Three solitaire games in one: Klondike (draw 1 or 3), Spider (1, 2 or 4 suits) and FreeCell with numbered deals. Klondike deals can always be won, hints come from a solver, and you get unlimited undo, daily deals and stats.
controls:
Drag cards, or click one to send it to the best spot
Click the stock to draw (or deal in Spider)
H: hint   Ctrl+Z: undo   N: new deal
Keyboard, controller and touch work too

title: GAMBIT
description: Chess against a built-in engine with eight levels, from beginner to strong, or with a friend on one device. It has hints, takebacks, optional clocks, a rating that grows as you win, game review and PGN export.
controls:
Drag a piece, or click it and then its target square
Right-drag to draw arrows
H: hint   F: flip   Ctrl+Z: takeback   Esc: menu
Home / End and [ ] step through the moves

title: JADE
description: Mahjong solitaire. Match free tiles in pairs to clear five layouts, from the classic Tortoise to Fortress and Twin Peaks. Every deal can be solved, and a shuffle keeps it that way if you get stuck.
controls:
Click two matching free tiles to remove them
H: hint   S: shuffle   Ctrl+Z: undo
Arrows + Enter pick tiles with the keyboard
Controller and touch work too

title: GLOOP
description: Drop squishy slimes into a tank. Two of a kind merge into the next size, and quick chains score combos. Grow all eleven slimes up to the King Gloop before the tank overflows.
controls:
Aim with the mouse and click to drop
Touch: drag to aim, let go to drop
← → aim, Space drops, X shakes the tank
Controller works too

title: STACKFALL
description: A fast falling-block puzzle game. It has modern rotation with wall kicks, hold, ghost pieces, T-spins, combos and perfect clears. Modes: Marathon, a 40-line Sprint, 2-minute Ultra, Dig, Zen and a Daily Sprint. Keys and handling can be changed.
controls:
Move: ← →   Soft drop: ↓   Hard drop: Space
Rotate: ↑ / X and Z / Ctrl   180°: A   Hold: C / Shift
Pause: Esc   Restart: R   (all keys can be changed)
Controller and touch work too

title: DEFUSE
description: Minesweeper with no-guess boards: every board can be cleared by logic alone, and your first click is always safe. Play Beginner, Intermediate, Expert, custom sizes or the daily board, with chording, hints, zoom and records.
controls:
Left click: open   Right click: flag
Click a number to open around it (chord)
Arrows + Space / F also work   H: hint   Scroll: zoom
Touch: tap to open, hold to flag, pinch to zoom

title: NINEFOLD
description: Sudoku graded by the techniques each puzzle needs, from Easy to Expert. It has notes, auto-notes, undo, mistake checking and hints that explain the logic, plus a daily puzzle and stats.
controls:
Click a cell, then a number (or type 1-9)
Notes: N or Shift+number   Fill notes: A
Undo: Ctrl+Z   Erase: Backspace   Hint: H
Controller and touch work too

title: INKGRID
description: Picture logic puzzles (nonograms). Use the number clues to ink in a hidden picture, then watch it fill with color. There are 24 hand-drawn puzzles in three packs, endless random puzzles and a daily 15 × 15, all solvable without guessing.
controls:
Left drag: ink   Right drag: cross out
Arrows + hold Z / X to ink or cross
H: hint   Ctrl+Z: undo   Esc: menu
Touch: pick Fill or Cross, then tap or drag

title: Last Lantern
description: A pixel-art survival roguelite. Your weapons fire on their own, so dodge the swarm, pick upgrades, evolve your weapons and survive 15 minutes until dawn. Unlock six keepers, three stages with bosses, and a daily night.
controls:
Move: WASD / arrows / stick / drag on touch
Weapons attack on their own
Level up: click a card, or 1-4
Pause: Esc / P / Start

title: GRIDLOCK
description: Neon tower defense on a new grid every game. Build and upgrade nine towers, hold the core for 30 waves or go endless, then design your own maps in the editor and share them as codes.
controls:
Build: pick a tower (1-9), then click a free tile
Click a tower to upgrade (U), sell (S) or retarget (T)
Space: next wave   F: speed   Esc: pause
Controller and touch work too

title: STARFORGE
description: An idle game about forging stardust. Click the star, build a solar system of 14 forges, catch golden comets, then go supernova for remnants and light constellations. It keeps forging while you're away.
controls:
Click the star (or press Space) to forge stardust
Buy forges and upgrades in the side panel
Catch golden comets when they fly past
Saves automatically

title: MOMENTUM
description: A pixel-art speedrun platformer. Chain jumps, wall kicks and dashes to keep your speed, race your own ghost through 10 levels with live splits, then build levels in the editor and share them as codes.
controls:
Move: Arrows / WASD
Jump: Space / Z
Dash: X / Shift (aim with a direction)
Restart level: R   Pause: Esc
Controller and touch work too

title: OCTIVE
description: A fast vertical-scrolling rhythm game. Hit the notes as they reach the line, climb the global rankings, take on the daily charts, and import your own .oct or osu! beatmaps.
controls:
4 keys: D F J K (change them in Settings → Input)
Works best in fullscreen
